## Triage verdict — #6054 is real; two sibling records cover parts of it, and the deletion-propagation record itself does not exist

Revalidated fresh (2026-11-08T13:00Z, current `main` `6f1efc4424`):

- **Issue OPEN**, no hard-stop labels. Parent **#6024** (licensing gate) is OPEN and triaged; it has not emitted a D.6 conclusion, so any deletion policy this record sets must stay a policy switch awaiting that answer.
- **No record for this cluster.** `doc/` has no deletion-propagation design (an exact search finds nothing), and `pkgs/` has no corpus purge path.
- **Two landed siblings already cover surface area — do not re-decide them:**
  - `doc/2026-11-08T10-26-00Z_design_atlas_content_versioning_retention/` §5.2 already rules that a tombstone head excludes a file from the newest-resolution view and does not let the previous version resurface; §4.4 already rules "report before deletion" and a tombstone record per retired version.
